# -- tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_grant_reward_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_grant_reward_effect = {
	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable value = 0 }
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_old_war_debts_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_old_war_debts_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_customs_dues_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_customs_dues_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_salt_tax_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_salt_tax_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_port_tolls_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_port_tolls_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_coin_assays_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_coin_assays_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_archive_volumes_status ?= 1 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 2 }
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_pledge_archive_volumes_status ?= 3 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable add = 1 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable >= 12 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_reward_modifier years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 5 }
		add_prestige = 5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable >= 8 }

	}
	else = {
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_reward_modifier_lesser years = -1 mode = add_and_extend }
		change_gold_effect = { scale = 1 }
	}
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_total_favorable
	remove_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_stage

	set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_completed value = 1 }

}

# -- tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_monthly_progress_effect ----------------------------------------------
tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_monthly_progress_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_active_trigger = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event }
		}
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_stage ?= 0 tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_site_control_trigger = yes }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1670 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_stage ?= 1 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1671 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_stage ?= 2 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1672 days = 1 }
		}
		else_if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_stage ?= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_bank_of_saint_george_ritual_pending_event value = 1 }
			trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.1673 days = 1 }
		}
	}
